text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALES - Pakistan overnight bought 282,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat and 47,000 tonnes of Australian wheat, a Pakistani embassy official confirmed. Early Wednesday exporters put the tonnage at 285,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat and 50,000 tonnes Australian wheat. Shipment was set for May 20-June 10.

- South Korea's Korea Flour Milling Corp said it bought 16,900 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat from Japanese trading house Mitsubishi Corp. Korea Flour said arrival was set to the city of Mokpo. Shipment was slated for June 1-30 from the PNW.

WHEAT SALE - South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd jointly bought 20,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat on Wednesday from Japanese trading house Mitsubishi Corp, company officials said. Shipment was set for June 15-July 15 to the southeastern port of Pusan.

WHEAT AND SOYBEAN SALE - A Philippine flour mill on Wednesday bought 7,500 tonnes U.S. western white wheat at $4.02 a bushel and 7,500 tonnes soybeans at $8.92. The mill deferred buying another 7,500 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat.
CORN TENDER - Taiwan's Members Feed Industry Group will tender on Thursday for a 54,000-tonne shipment of U.S. No.2 corn for July shipment, traders said.

FLOUR TENDER - Yemen has launched a May 13 import tender for 150,000 tonnes of soft wheat flour, European traders said. The tender calls for shipment between August and October and the flour is expected to come from the European Union, the United States or both, they said.
SOYBEAN TENDER - South Korea's state-run Agricultural and Fishery Marketing Corp would seek 40,000 tonnes of No.1 soybean on May 16. The bids will close on May 15.

SOYMEAL TENDER - El Salvador was retendering for about 8,000 to 10,000 tonnes U.S. soybean meal in bulk under the PL-480 export program, its U.S. export agent said. The soymeal was set for June 1-15, July 1-31 and/or August 1-31 delivery. Offers were to be submitted no later than May 12 and will be valid until May 13.

RAPESEED MEAL - A South Korean buyer group, known as the Feed Buying Group, has invited tenders to buy 31,000 tonnes of rapeseed meal on Friday. They said the buyer group had also invited tenders to buy 13,500 tonnes of cottonseed meal and 11,500 tonnes of palm kernel meal on the same day.

BARLEY TENDER - The Cyprus Grain Commission on Wednesday issued a tender for the supply of one cargo consisting 25,000 tonnes of barley with a scheduled shipment in May or June, it said. The tender closes on Tuesday, May 13.

WHEAT TENDERS - Sri Lanka seeks 100,000 tonnes HRW wheat in two lots of 50,000 tonnes. Tenders close on May 16. The first shipment was for May 22-June 5 if from the U.S., Canada, Europe or Argentina, and June 10-19 from Australia or Saudi Arabia. The second shipment was for June 16-25 if from U.S., Canada, the Continent or Argentina, and June 30-July 9 from Australia or Saudi Arabia.

WHEAT TENDER - Bulgaria will call a tender by the end of the week to import 50,000 tonnes of bread wheat to help cover its grain shortage until the new crop comes in, Deputy Agriculture Minister Alexander Rangelov said. The country needed about 100,000 tonnes of wheat to fill the gap and a tender to import 50,000 tonnes, against exports of the same quantity from the new crop, would be called within days.
-Three more Philippine mills sought tenders on Wednesday for 35,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, traders said.
Earlier, traders said they received tender invitations for a total of 55,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat and 7,500 tonnes of soybeans following the overnight drop in U.S. prices.
SUNOIL TENDER - The CCC was tendering on May 7 for 3,000 tonnes of U.S. crude sunflower seed oil for export to Mozambique, June 1-20 shipment.
SUNFLOWER SEED OIL TENDER - CCC seeks 2,000 tonnes refined U.S. sunflower seed oil for donation under its export program to Bosnia. Offers were due on May 13.
RICE TENDERS - Jordan seeks 15,000 tonnes of medium grain camolina type rice for delivery in June.
- Jamaica was tendering for about 3,000 tonnes U.S. rice in bulk under the PL-480 donation program, its U.S. export agent said. The delivery date was set for May 20-June 5.
- Costa Rican millers were privately negotiating with exporters this week for 26,500 tonnes of optional origin long grain rough rice for June 30-July 7 shipment.
